snippet.title: Poke A Nose - Official Gameplay Trailer - IGN Live 2026
snippet.description:
You're a severed hand on a mission. Every nose must be poked. Thrust through a hand-drawn black-and-white world, poke bosses, and collect toilet paper coins along the way. Watch the Poke A Nose gameplay trailer for this upcoming side-scrolling action adventure game with thrust physics, upgradable power-ups, and secrets to discover. Poke A Nose will be available on PC.

#IGN #IGNLive #SummerOfGaming
